name: Deaconess
overview: The New Testament presents the role of deaconesses as servants within the early church, emphasizing their practical ministry and care for others. Acts 6:1 highlights the need for organized service to ensure widows were not neglected, while Romans 16:1 commends Phebe as a servant of the church, indicating the active participation of women in ministry roles. Philippians 1:1 references deacons alongside church leaders, underscoring the importance of faithful service in the body of Christ.
